searchText: I have a question regarding 7702 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7702#behavior Rule (3) adds `authority` to `accessed_addresses`. What if a verification fails (e.g. 4 or 5), does this keep authority in the accessed addresses or does it remove it? (I assume keep it in?) It should keep it as both steps 4. and 5. require loaded account from db. Yes, makes sense, was also my line of thought, thanks 🙂

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content:
I have a question regarding 7702

https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7702#behavior

Rule (3) adds `authority` to `accessed_addresses`. What if a verification fails (e.g. 4 or 5), does this keep authority in the accessed addresses or does it remove it? (I assume keep it in?)

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: It should keep it as both steps 4. and 5. require loaded account from db.

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Yes, makes sense, was also my line of thought, thanks 🙂
